title: Mobile Engineer
summary: Designs, builds, and ships native or cross-platform mobile applications across iOS, Android, React Native, and/or Flutter.

skills.name: Git
skills.question: Have you used Git for version control in a professional setting?

skills.name: REST APIs
skills.question: Have you integrated a mobile app with backend REST APIs?

skills.name: CI/CD
skills.question: Have you set up or maintained a CI/CD pipeline for a mobile app?

skills.name: Mobile App Architecture
skills.question: Have you owned the architecture of a mobile app feature end-to-end (design through release)?

skills.name: Performance & Memory Optimization
skills.question: Have you profiled and fixed a performance or memory issue in a shipped mobile app?

skills.name: Kotlin
skills.question: Do you have professional experience writing production Android apps in Kotlin?

skills.name: Unit & Integration Testing
skills.question: Do you write automated unit or integration tests for mobile code as standard practice?

skills.name: App Store / Play Store Release Management
skills.question: Have you managed a mobile app's release process through the App Store or Google Play?

skills.name: React Native
skills.question: Have you shipped a production cross-platform app with React Native?

skills.name: TypeScript
skills.question: Have you built a React Native app using TypeScript?

skills.name: Push Notifications
skills.question: Have you implemented push notifications in a production mobile app?

skills.name: Swift
skills.question: Do you have professional experience writing production iOS apps in Swift?

skills.name: Offline-First & Data Sync
skills.question: Have you built offline-first functionality with local/remote data sync in a mobile app?

skills.name: Local Data Persistence
skills.question: Have you used an on-device database such as SQLite, Realm, Core Data, or Room?

skills.name: Mobile Accessibility (a11y)
skills.question: Have you implemented or audited a mobile app for accessibility (VoiceOver/TalkBack)?

skills.name: State Management
skills.question: Have you used a state-management library (Redux, Zustand, MobX, etc.) in a mobile app?

skills.name: Crash Reporting & Observability
skills.question: Have you set up crash reporting or observability tooling (e.g. Sentry, Crashlytics) for a mobile app?

skills.name: Automated UI Testing
skills.question: Have you written automated UI/end-to-end tests for a mobile app (Espresso, Detox, XCUITest)?

skills.name: SwiftUI
skills.question: Have you built production iOS screens using SwiftUI?

skills.name: Jetpack Compose

skills.name: GraphQL
skills.question: Have you consumed a GraphQL API from a mobile app (e.g. via Apollo)?

skills.name: Kotlin Multiplatform (KMM)
skills.question: Have you shared business logic between iOS and Android using Kotlin Multiplatform?

skills.name: Expo
skills.question: Have you built or shipped a React Native app using the Expo managed workflow?

skills.name: Flutter / Dart
skills.question: Do you have professional experience building apps with Flutter and Dart?

skills.name: Android SDK
skills.question: Do you have hands-on experience with the native Android SDK?

skills.name: AI-Assisted Development
skills.question: Do you use AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Copilot, Claude Code) in your day-to-day workflow?

skills.name: Code Review & Mentorship
skills.question: Have you mentored other engineers or led code reviews on a mobile team?

skills.name: AWS
skills.question: Have you worked with AWS as the backend for a mobile application?

skills.name: Objective-C
skills.question: Do you have experience maintaining legacy Objective-C code in an iOS app?

skills.name: Java (Android)
skills.question: Do you have experience maintaining legacy Java code in an Android app?

skills.name: Bluetooth / BLE

skills.name: Docker
